review_scope: Checked the same-world bidirectional joint-payoff manipulation and the fixed-versus-rotating partner schedule.
Checked the predeclared four-source endpoint primary metric, source-level differences, fixed-checkpoint AUC and same-private-type message agreement.
Checked all eight ordered cross-type protocols, two-partner simultaneous correctness and FW/WF recombination against 199 complete-code relabelings.
Checked independent raw statistics, bounded endpoint/joint-trace replay, formal input/source hash binding and raster figure QA.
Checked every absolute local link in the v0.32 report.

findings.interpretation: The joint same-round payoff and partner rotation do not yield a consistent endpoint grounded-target effect across the four independent sources.
Message-form agreement rises in every source while grounded target performance does not; agreement is therefore not a sufficient semantic criterion.
Requiring both partners to be correct on the same resource remains near zero, so a shared reward alone does not establish compositional multi-partner communication.
Offline donor recombination exceeds the full-code relabeling reference, but this is descriptive and cannot establish autonomous online composition.

limitations: The four population members reuse two frozen private encoders; this is controlled private variation rather than natural demographic or generational change.
Partner rotation is a fixed four-agent schedule without birth, death, migration, cultural transmission or generation turnover.
The task is a symbolic resource-location protocol, not a reconstruction of complete human ecology.
The bounded audit replays all endpoint sender worlds and receiver tables plus selected joint traces, but not every gradient or Adam transition.
The four initialization sources are the independent units; panels, directions, masks and photos are nested repeats.
The 199 complete-code relabeling reference is descriptive and cannot be used as an independent four-source significance test.
next_step: Make one receiver action depend on two non-interchangeable senders with complementary private observations, while retaining fixed/rotating, single-sender and random-message controls. Add delayed third-party relay only after this information-complementarity manipulation is evaluated.

figure_visual_qa.method: PIL raster dimension/finite/nonwhite checks plus direct visual inspection with view_image
